newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity down in November.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity down in November.

text.p: Construction activity in Lebanon continued a slowing trend in November, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
Cement deliveries dropped to 354,000 tonnes from 368,000 tonnes in October, 376,000 tonnes in September and 391,639 tonnes in August.
"Cement deliveries reached 354,000 tonnes during this month (November)," the bulletin said, adding this was a year-on-year increase of 17.1 percent.
The construction permits area approved in November by the Association of Engineers declined by 73.3 percent from a year earlier, the Bank said.
"Total real estate fees collected increased during November by 18.2 percent from a year earlier to 24.8 billion pounds," it added.
($1 = 1,554 Lebanese pounds at end of November)
